identity: University of Groningen, Archaeology BA, 2027–28 redesign

sources.scope: Current official programme page: degree, published redesigned courses, regional choices, sequence and IMPACT themes.
2026–27 programme regulations: Arts. 4.1 and 5.1, transitional rules and Annex 1, which specifies the complete redesign planned for 2027–28.

curriculum: The mainly Dutch-taught Archaeology BA totals 180 EC. Annex 1 expressly dates the complete redesigned curriculum to 2027–28. It corroborates the public programme table: 60 EC each year, including 10 EC of first-year fieldwork, 10 EC of second-year geoarchaeology and fieldwork, and a third year with a 30 EC minor, two 5 EC theory and research-design courses, 10 EC of faculty-wide electives and a 10 EC archaeology thesis. The temporary 2026–27 structure substitutes an excursion and fieldwork course for the combined geoarchaeology and fieldwork course and uses transitional optional modules in years two and three. It is a separate implementation. Annex 1 provides a complete designed degree and the public page describes its educational progression. Neither source designates the regional working groups as separate degree tracks.
progression: The official overview places the first-year classical heritage course before excavation and places introductory methods and materials before the second-year specialist biological, GIS and geoarchaeology courses. Regional workshops in the two thematic courses allow Northwest European or Mediterranean focus. The third year begins with a minor or study abroad, followed by theory, data analysis and research design in preparation for the thesis, alongside a faculty-wide course. These are the published curriculum sequence and choices. Article 7.1 for 2026–27 requires all eight first-year courses before thesis and thesis class. The redesign preserves the first-year foundation and a final thesis. Any separate updated rule for 2027–28 remains subject to its future regulations.
